{{Quote|The Phoebos Run is the biggest&mdash;named after some mechanic who started the sport.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|<ref name="SW13">[[Star Wars (1998) 13|''Star Wars'' (1998) 13]]</ref>}}
'''Phoebos''' was the creator of the first [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]. An engineer, he was brazen enough to attach a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] cockpit to two jet engines. The [[Phoebos Memorial Run/Legends|Phoebos Memorial Run]] race on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] was named in his honor.
